claims.statement: Tom Allen was born at Birmingham, England, on April 23; the article gives his age as twenty-nine (the year is printed as 1519, so 1840 is worked out from his age).
claims.excerpt: was born at Birmingham, England, April 23d, 1519,

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Morris Connor in twelve rounds, lasting twenty minutes, for $25 a side.
claims.excerpt: fought him for $25 aside. Connor was demolished in twelve rounds, of twenty minutes duration.

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat White in eight rounds, lasting fifteen minutes, for $25 a side.
claims.excerpt: whipped White for the same amount of cash in eight rounds, lasting fifteen minates

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Gould in thirty-one rounds, lasting fifty-three minutes, for $75.
claims.excerpt: he met Gould tor $75 stakes, and beat him in thirty-one ronnds, of fifty-three minutes

claims.statement: Tom Allen lost to Posh Price in forty rounds, lasting fifty-five minutes, for $100 a side.

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Bingy Rose in ten rounds, lasting fifteen minutes, for $250 a side.
claims.excerpt: Resting two years he beat Bingy Rose for $250 a side in ten roundsand fifteen minutes.

claims.statement: Tom Allen lost to Bob Smith, the Black, after three hours and twenty minutes, for $25 a side.

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Jack Parkinson in fifteen rounds, lasting twenty-two minutes, for $250 a side (the year is printed as i885, read as 1865 from the sequence).
claims.excerpt: he fought Jack Parkinson for $250 a side and wen-the money in fifteen rounds

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Posh Price in a rematch in fifty-eight rounds, lasting two hours and five minutes, for $250 a side.

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat George Iles in eighteen rounds, lasting fifty-five minutes, for $500 a side.
claims.excerpt: he conquered George Hes tor $500 aside, in eighteen rounds, lasting fifty-five minutes

claims.statement: Tom Allen fought Joe Goss for the championship and $2,990 a side on March 5 (printed as 1887; the year is read as 1867 from the sequence); the battle ended in a draw.
claims.excerpt: he fought Joe Goss for the championship and $2,990 a side, but the battle termimated in a draw

claims.statement: After the draw with Joe Goss, Tom Allen emigrated from England to America.
claims.excerpt: Whereupon our hero emigrated to America

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Bill Davis in forty rounds, lasting forty minutes, for $1,000 a side.
claims.excerpt: he whipped Bill Davis in forty rounds, lasting forty mimutes, for $1,000 a side

claims.statement: Charley Gallagher beat Tom Allen in two rounds, lasting three minutes, for $1,900 (printed; OCR).
claims.excerpt: Soon afterwards Gallagher knocked him out of time and $1,900 in two rounds, of only three minutes.

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Mike McCoole in nine rounds, lasting fourteen minutes, on June 15, 1869 (printed as t5th); Allen did not receive the stakes.
claims.excerpt: “went through” Mike McCoole in nine rounds, lasting fourteen minutes

claims.statement: On July 13, 1869, Tom Allen and Charley Gallagher made a match for $500 a side and the excursion money, to be fought on August 17 within fifty miles of St. Louis.
claims.excerpt: on the 13th of July a match was made for $500 a side and the excursic,,.money

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Charley Gallagher fought at Foster's Island on August 17, 1869, and the referee declared the fight a draw.
claims.excerpt: The Referee Decides the Fight a Draw.
